mapper.sql: sys27_login_manage_id AS login_manage_id, sys27_company_id AS company_id, sys27_person_id AS person_id, sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(sys27_person_id) AS person_nm, TO_CHAR(sys27_open_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS open_date_string, sys27_place_cd AS place_cd, f_cdnm('LoginPlaceCode', sys27_place_cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS place_nm, sys27_mac_address AS mac_address, sys27_reason AS reason, sys27_confirm_yn AS confirm_yn, TO_CHAR(sys27_confirm_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS confirm_date_string
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys27_login_manage INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys27_company_id = sys01_company_id WHERE sys27_login_manage_id = #{loginManageId}
